kind.pick: What kind of card game is {label}?
kind.match: Match each card game to its kind.
kind.odd: Three of these are {value} card games. Which one isn't?

rows.label: blackjack
rows.hook: challenges players to build a hand worth as close to 21 points as possible without going over

rows.label: Magic: The Gathering
rows.hook: has players cast spells and summon fantasy creatures to defeat an opponent across two-player duels

rows.label: poker
rows.hook: built its reputation on bluffing opponents while assembling the best five-card hand at the table

rows.label: Texas hold 'em
rows.description: variation of the card game of poker
rows.hook: became the version most often shown on television, played by dealing two cards face down to each player

rows.label: Pokémon Trading Card Game
rows.description: 1996 collectible card game based on Pokémon
rows.hook: has players collect and battle with creatures from a globally popular video-turned-cartoon franchise

rows.label: Rummy
rows.hook: challenges players to match cards into sets and runs before anyone else empties their hand

rows.label: contract bridge
rows.hook: is played by four people in two partnerships who bid on how many tricks they expect to win

rows.label: Klondike
rows.hook: became the single-player game most computers ship as their default way to pass the time

rows.label: Gin rummy
rows.hook: is a fast two-player matching game played to a target score across several quick hands

rows.label: hanafuda
rows.hook: features cards illustrated with flowers and seasons, and inspired the founding of a major video game company

rows.label: cribbage
rows.description: English two-player card game using a wooden board with pegs
rows.hook: is scored by moving pegs along a wooden board as players count up combinations from their hand

rows.label: Canasta
rows.hook: revolves around building matching sets of seven cards that earn a large bonus once completed

rows.label: Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game
rows.hook: grew out of a manga and anime about duelists who summon monsters and cast spells to battle
